Windows 95 workloads are dominated by file I/O, that the I/O patterns are very bursty, and that the file system is heavily used.
the Windows 95 file system exhibits the following characteristics: 1. It is heavily used, with a total of about 1,000,000 accesses to 100,000 files per day.
